# Derived data licence

Niall Newsham and Francisco Rowe license the derived data in `site/data/` and `data_review/` under [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

When reusing the data, credit Niall Newsham and Francisco Rowe, link to the licence and [Shrinking places](https://fcorowe.github.io/pop-decline-dashboard/), indicate any changes, and cite the relevant studies:

- Newsham, N., & Rowe, F. (2023, first published online in 2022). Understanding trajectories of population decline across rural and urban Europe: A sequence analysis. *Population, Space and Place*, 29(3), e2630. https://doi.org/10.1002/psp.2630
- Newsham, N., & Rowe, F. (2025). The demographic causes of European sub-national population declines. *European Journal of Population*, 41, Article 10. https://doi.org/10.1007/s10680-025-09730-0

The Natural Earth land polygons used to estimate shoreline distance are [public domain](https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/).
